product_one_liner.value: Syren provides enterprise data engineering, AI agents and supply-chain intelligence that help businesses modernize data platforms, automate workflows and make faster operational decisions.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or plan page was found; the pricing URL yielded no readable page.

named_customers.notes: The employer company profile explicitly identifies these organizations as clients; Johnson & Johnson is also named in the DQS case study.

employee_band.notes: The employer profile lists 201–500 employees; the funding database reports 385 as of September 30, 2026.

founded_year.notes: The company and employer profiles state 2020; Tracxn instead labels the company founded in 2019.

eng_blog.notes: Technical implementation posts by Solution Architect Shivam Porwal (June 9, 2026) and Srikant Kalaga, Senior Delivery Manager—Customer Success & Engineering (November 28, 2025).

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help-center or developer-portal link was found on the site; no readable docs/help subdomain pages were found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live AI Engineer & Knowledge Graph/Ontology posting lists one opening and an application option.

model_provider.value: Databricks Mosaic AI (Genie and Knowledge Assistant)
model_provider.notes: Disclosed for Sales Journey AI; this does not imply every Syren product uses the same provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The company profile explicitly claims these certifications; GDPR and HIPAA are reproduced as company claims, not independently verified certifications.

last_funding.notes: Funding profiles report no funding rounds; no round date or amount applies.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile, updated October 17, 2026, reports no funding rounds. Window: May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable 20-role job board lists technical roles and no qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive title. Historical SDR recruiting descriptions do not establish a live vacancy.

launched_6mo.notes: Sales Journey AI was announced June 9, 2026 with early-access deployments; the July 2, 2026 TrueTrack announcement describes the portal as live in production.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Chetan Deshpande’s profile dates his start as SVP—Sales & GTM, Data & AI at Syren to October 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named in a Syren Demand Generation Manager recruiting post as required experience or alternatives; the post is a stack signal, not confirmation that every listed alternative is deployed.
